title: Ed4All provenance_resolution_report.json
description: Provenance-resolution report — whether course-page citations (data-cf-source-ids tokens on the IMSCC chunkset) resolve to their book source. Built by lib/aggregators/provenance_resolution.py::ProvenanceResolutionAggregator post-workflow and emitted at <libv2_course>/quality/provenance_resolution_report.json (<project_path> fallback).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call (trailing 'Z').

staging_dir_used.description: The staged accessible-HTML root used for anchor resolution, or null when none resolved (anchor metric then skipped).

distinct_source_id_count.description: Count of distinct non-empty data-cf-source-ids tokens across the whole chunkset.

chunks_with_provenance.description: count = chunks carrying >=1 non-empty token; total = total chunks.

source_ids_anchor_resolved.description: count = distinct tokens whose {anchor} exists as a data-dart-block-id in the staged {stem}.html; total = distinct tokens. Skipped shape when no staging-HTML root resolves.

source_ids_book_chunk_resolved.description: count = distinct tokens carried by >=1 book-side dart chunk's source.source_references[].sourceId; total = distinct tokens.

provenance_free_by_module.description: Per-module_id count of provenance-free chunks (no non-empty token). Keyed by source.module_id ('unknown' when absent).

notes.description: Human-readable explanation of the empty-provenance (Wave-27) semantics and the resolution methodology.

unresolved.description: Capped (<=25) sample of distinct tokens that did NOT resolve.
